title: fix(plugin-gantt): a lookup parentField nests its tasks
body:
Fixes #34395

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:甘特图的「父任务字段」是查找(lookup)字段时,子任务重新挂到父任务下面显示,不再全部平铺。
- 为什么改:甘特图读记录时会自动展开查找字段,父字段拿到的是整条父记录而不是它的 id;任务树按 id 找父任务,于是一个都对不上。HotCRM 项目任务(`parent_task` 自查找)实测命中。
- 风险与回滚:风险低,只改一处取值:展开后的对象取 `id`(没有再取 `_id`),原本就是 id 的值原样通过,空值仍是顶层。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx` 的 `taskParentId` 及其唯一调用处(`parent:` 那一行);再看 `ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 `ObjectGantt.lookupParent-34395` 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run -t lookupParent packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ObjectGantt` builds each task's `parent` from the record's `parentField`. The record query auto-`$expand`s every lookup, so for a lookup (or self-lookup) `parentField` the value is the related row, not its id; the task tree keys parents by id, so no child matched its parent and every task drew flat, on both the object-gantt block and the gantt list view.

A new local helper, `taskParentId`, reads an object parent down to `id`, falling back to `_id`, the same read `normalizeDependencies` already makes of an expanded predecessor (and `ObjectTree`'s `parentIdOf` makes of the same rows). A scalar id passes through unchanged and a null or missing parent stays `null`, so a `parentField` that already held a bare id behaves exactly as before. No existing exported helper fit: `extractLookupId` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is not part of that package's public entry and also falls back to `.value` and maps arrays.

The quick-filter ancestor walk in the same component reads `task.parent` too, so a quick filter on a lookup-parent gantt now keeps a matching child's ancestors as it already did for scalar parents.

Changeset: `.changeset/34395-gantt-lookup-parent-nests.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-gantt` patch), at the repository root, where `ui/AGENTS.md` (Housekeeping) puts every new changeset; the root config does not read `ui/.changeset/`.

## Tests

New top-level block `ObjectGantt.lookupParent-34395` in the shared harness `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.harness.test.tsx` (a new `ObjectGantt` pin joins that file rather than opening a new one). It renders the real `ObjectGantt` over a `psa_task` object with a `parent_task` self-lookup and reads the tasks handed to the `GanttView` stand-in:

- an expanded lookup parent (`{ id: 'p1', … }`) gives the child `parent === 'p1'`, the parent task's own id; the case also asserts the query asked for `$expand` of `parent_task`;
- an expanded parent carrying only `_id` resolves through it;
- CONTROL: a scalar id parent still nests;
- CONTROL: a null and a missing parent stay top-level.

That the tree nests a task whose `parent` equals another task's id is the other half, already pinned in `GanttView.tree.test.tsx`.
